page.overview:
Who is Clown?

This is a candy seller in a Marleyan port town.

The clown is a man of average height and build. He is shown dressed up in a costume with a pink waistcoat, a green collar, vertically striped sleeves and pants of alternating black and yellow color, white, long-cuffed gloves and a beige, visored hat with black, radial stripes covering its crown. He is seen wearing a white base all over his face, with black paint drawing triangles above and below his eyes, and a black clown nose. His hair is dyed green.

This clown seems to be off-putting, given how he creepily snuck behind Levi Ackerman.

One day while selling lollipops at a Marleyan harbor, this clown sees Levi Ackerman. Thinking he was a child, the clown asks him if he would like a lollipop. Upon being ignored, the clown sneaks behind Levi, reaffirming he was addressing him. Seeing how the Survey Corps members that are exploring Marley and Onyankopon are dressed, he asks whether they are playing gangster.
